lawns.line: Hear the hissing of summer lawns
stanza: He bought her a diamond for her throat
He put her in a ranch house on a hill
She could see the valley barbecues
See the blue pools in the squinting sun
Hear the hissing of summer lawns

lawns.line: "See the trees' shadows lie in black pools in the lawns"
stanza: You keep your socks on in bed
"See the trees' shadows lie in black pools in the lawns"
You're the breeze in my Austin nights
